free_tier.stated: 100 messages/day, 1 custom domain, 1 inbound route, 2 API keys, 1-day log retention
free_tier.notes: Without a card on file the Free plan sends from the sandbox domain only to authorized recipients: up to 5 addresses, each verified when its owner clicks an invitation link. A card on file allows custom domains, which send to any recipient; a custom domain must be verified through DNS before it sends.

retention.stated: logs and the Events API keep 1 day

chaining: 100/day out with one domain and one inbound route, so it composes with one domain and with no fan-out.

identity_cost.detail: Signup asks for a work email, a full name and a company; every account is then activated by an email link and a mobile phone number verified by an SMS one-time password, and VoIP, virtual and landline numbers are refused. No card is needed to open a Free plan account, but without a card on file it sends only to authorized recipients; a card on file unlocks custom domains, which send to any recipient.

reliability_note: phone verification refuses VoIP, virtual and landline numbers, and repeated code requests can place a temporary hold on the account
